sloka: अथ धौत उपल तलाम् तोय ओघैः सहसा उत्थितैः ।वेलाम् आसाद्य विपुलाम् रामो वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥६-४-९९॥।।
transliteration: atha dhauta upala talām toya oghaiḥ sahasā utthitaiḥ ।velām āsādya vipulām rāmo vacanam abravīt ॥6-4-99॥।।

translations.english: Atonce Rama sprung from there (top of mountain) on to an extensive surface of the earth polished by the waves of the ocean spoke these words on reaching there.
